dataset.name: HMU stage I FFPE lung adenocarcinoma RNA-seq cohort (GSE143486)
dataset.description: Independent resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma cohort with FFPE tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study collected 76 stage I lung adenocarcinoma FFPE tumors after curative-intent surgical resection at Harbin Medical University Cancer Hospital. RNA-seq libraries were generated for the 30 specimens with RIN greater than 2, an expression-quality rule independent of outcome. All 30 sequenced patients have individual overall-survival time and vital status.
dataset.publication_citation: Zhang et al. Briefings in Bioinformatics 2021

metadata.source_program: Harbin Medical University Cancer Hospital stage I lung adenocarcinoma study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Briefings in Bioinformatics
metadata.library_method: Directional paired-end bulk RNA sequencing of surgically resected FFPE lung adenocarcinoma, aligned to GRCh38 with HISAT2 and quantified with featureCounts 1.6.3 against GENCODE v32
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival from initial surgical resection to death or last contact
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The cohort is restricted to stage I tumors and to the 30 of 76 archived FFPE specimens with RIN greater than 2. Results therefore describe the sequenced RNA-quality subset rather than every collected case.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The source study selected the 30 sequenced specimens by the prespecified technical RIN greater than 2 criterion. Every released profile has complete OS time and status, and there is one profile per patient.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Age, sex, stage, TN classification, treatment, OS time and vital status are embedded in the GEO family SOFT. TRACE Explorer preserves source-provided fields, including internally unusual stage/T/N combinations, without silent correction.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The released matrix contains 60,564 GENCODE v32 Ensembl gene rows for 30 samples. One row is NA in every sample and is excluded without imputation. TRACE Explorer computes log2(CPM + 1) over the remaining 60,563 rows, maps all of them against the exact pinned GENCODE v32 annotation and excludes 69 ambiguous symbols, leaving 59,298 analyzable symbols.
metadata.overlap_note: The HMU FFPE cohort is independent of TCGA-LUAD and of the active Uppsala, TCIA radiogenomics, NYU, Steiner, CPTAC, CAS and POG570 lung adenocarcinoma releases.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO count matrix in place. Direct source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Curative-intent resected stage I FFPE lung adenocarcinoma

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned GENCODE v32 GRCh38 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols assigned to more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 60,564 source rows for each tumor and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are intended for within-cohort analysis, particularly given the FFPE source material.
